solution:

$$\frac{4}{5} \times \frac{5}{6} \times \frac{1}{8} \times N = 4365$$
$$\frac{1}{12} N = 4365 \implies N = 4365 \times 12 = 52380$$
Now calculate 65% of $N$:
$$65\% \times 52380 = 0.65 \times 52380 = 34047$$
Hence, the correct option is C.

questionText: The value of $\frac{3 + 8 \times 8 \div 8 \text{ of } 8 + 7 \div 7 \times 2}{5 \div 5 \text{ of } 4 + 3 \times 3 \div 3 - 3 + 2}$ is:
solution:
Numerator:

$$7 \div 7 \times 2 = 1 \times 2 = 2$$
$$\text{Numerator} = 3 + 1 + 2 = 6$$
Denominator:

$$5 \div 20 = \frac{1}{4}$$
$$3 \times 3 \div 3 = 3$$
$$\text{Denominator} = \frac{1}{4} + 3 - 3 + 2 = 2\frac{1}{4} = \frac{9}{4}$$
Value:
$$\frac{6}{9/4} = \frac{24}{9} = \frac{8}{3} = 2\frac{2}{3}$$
Hence, the correct option is B.

typeHeader: TYPE - I: BASED ON BODMAS RULE
questionText: Which of the following can be the values of $k$, if $\frac{(88 \div 8 \times k - 3 \times 3)}{(6^2 - 7 \times 5 + k^2)} = 1$?
solution:
Numerator: $88 \div 8 \times k - 9 = 11k - 9$.
Denominator: $6^2 - 35 + k^2 = 36 - 35 + k^2 = k^2 + 1$.
Given:
$$\frac{11k - 9}{k^2 + 1} = 1$$
$$11k - 9 = k^2 + 1$$
$$k^2 - 11k + 10 = 0$$
$$(k - 1)(k - 10) = 0 \implies k = 1 \text{ or } k = 10$$
Hence, the correct option is A.
